decisions.reason: A is a renamed existing trommel screen with proven demand, so its option value remains high and the cost of keeping it is low.
B has a dedicated page and a full model line, indicating sufficient market validation to keep this option open.

C has only had a brief mention and its mobile grinder option overlaps with the already dropped E and existing B, so after several years without stronger validation the option is no longer worth keeping.
D remains a narrow stationary niche with no dedicated page, and the limited initial visibility suggests its option value is unlikely to be realized, so abandon it.
F has its own page and a model line, signaling a promising option that still justifies continued commitment.
